title: Metal folding drying rack
text: Metal folding drying rack. Barely lasted 6 months.  Screws continually pulling out of cross pieces causing rack to collapse or lean over. Lots of wobble..  2nd rack to fail with short usable life..  pro: doesn't split and crack like inexpensive wood racks..  once screws come loose... can never tighten to original condition..  beyond 4 or 5 t shirts... cannot tolerate weight
